name: Virginia

agency.name: Virginia Department of Energy (Virginia Energy), Division of Gas and Oil

form.name: Application for a New Permit, Permit Modification, or Transfer of Permit Rights (with notice, plat and technical data forms)
form.number: DGO-GO-1 (rev. 6/09 in 4VAC25-150-9998); plat DGO-GO-7; technical data DGO-GO-9; operations plan checklist DGO-GO-12; drilling report DGO-GO-14; completion report DGO-GO-15
form.notes: NOT READ: the blank form was not found (the Code lists form numbers and revision dates only, no link; a search found no PDF). Filing is online through the agency's eForms login (https://www.energy.virginia.gov/DGOEforms/frmlogin.aspx). Form cells come from 4VAC25-150-80, -90 and -500 (law.lis.virginia.gov) and the permit requirements page, marked evidence 'doc' or 'web', and many are 'unknown'.

permit_number.n: FiNo (file number) in the wells layers; taken as the tracking number, not confirmed as permit no.

well_name.n: FiOperation (operation name, e.g. a well designation)

lease_name.n: FiFarm (farm name); ApFarm on pending wells

bond.n: 4VAC25-150-80 B: bond under Code 45.2-1633; web page: bond for reclamation and plugging

district.n: TblInCode (inspector code), TblCnZone; layer 7 'DGO Inspector Areas'; meaning inferred

surface_latlon.n: Point geometry; FiStPlaneX/Y in State Plane feet, Virginia South, NAD83

surface_plss.n: 4VAC25-150-90 D.3: courses and distances from two landmarks on the plat

elevation.n: FiElev (ApElev on pending wells); plat shows elevation (90 D.1)

surface_owner.n: 4VAC25-150-80 C: persons to be notified, incl. surface owners; proof of notice

well_type.n: TblOpDesc: Coal Bed, Gas, Gas/Pipeline, Horizontal Gas, Service Well...

work_type.n: DGO-GO-1 covers new permit, modification, transfer; map has a Pending Well Modifications layer

well_direction.n: Only through TblOpDesc values 'Horizontal Gas' and 'Horizontal Coalbed'

proposed_depth_md.n: 4VAC25-150-500 A: approximate depth to be drilled; layer TotalDepth is for active wells

formation_tops.n: 4VAC25-150-500 A: depth and thickness of known coal, groundwater and gas/oil strata

casing_program.n: 4VAC25-150-500 A: each string's size, top and bottom depth

cement_program.n: 4VAC25-150-500 A: extent to which each string is cemented

h2s.n: 4VAC25-150-80 C: hydrogen sulfide information, if applicable

pit_waste.n: Operations plan: pit design, disposal of pit fluids, produced water, cuttings (permit page)

water.n: Drilling and stimulating plan covers water and fluids; source and volume not confirmed

fracture_plan.n: 4VAC25-150-80 C: list of anticipated hydraulic fracturing ingredients

spacing_unit.n: 4VAC25-150-90 A: plat covers the board-approved drilling unit

mineral_owner.n: 4VAC25-150-80 C and permit page: notice to mineral and coal owners

fee.n: 4VAC25-150-80 B: permit fee (Code 45.2-1631) and Orphaned Well Fund fee

notice_hearing.n: Notice to affected parties, local government and newspaper; objections allowed (permit page)

date_approved.n: Layers have FiStatDt (status date), not a labeled issue date; 'Permit Issuance' report unread

completion_date.n: FiWellComp and FiDrComp (drilling complete) on Active Wells layer

status.n: TblPsDesc: Issued, Construction, Constructed Waiting On Rig, Constructed/Never Drilled

plat_image.n: 4VAC25-150-90: certified plat, form DGO-GO-7; an online scan is not verified

form_image.n: DGO Inquiry lists 'Permitted Applications/File Scans'; page title only, not opened

completion_report.n: DGO Inquiry lists 'Completion Report' under Well Records; not opened (form DGO-GO-15)

logs.n: DGO Inquiry lists 'Geophysical Logs' under Well Records; not opened

production_link.n: DGO Inquiry lists monthly gas and oil production reports; not opened

sources.tested: Service ?f=json 200 (4.3 KB; 8 layers; Map,Query,Data; maxRecordCount 2000). Layers 4, 0 and 1 ?f=json 200 (6 KB each). One grouped statistics query on layer 4: 197 undrilled permitted wells, TblPsDesc Issued/Construction/Constructed Waiting On Rig/Constructed/Never Drilled, FiStatDt from 2001-09-28 to 2026-10-30 (newest 'Issued' 2026-10-30). Almost all wells are coalbed methane or gas; no oil category seen. 6 requests to energy.virginia.gov in all, 3-5 s apart.

sources.tested: Page read through WebFetch only (no curl request): lists the report names above; coordinates are State Plane feet, Virginia South, NAD83; the reports themselves were not opened, so whether 'Permit Issuance' carries issue dates is unverified (has_approval_date left false for that reason).

grade_reason: The ArcGIS well layers are free, no login and answered from here, one record per well, but they hold only a status date (FiStatDt), a drilling-complete date and a well-completion date, not a labeled permit issue date, and a well leaves the 'undrilled' layer once drilled. Counts of wells completed per month are possible; permits issued per month are not from the layers. The 'Permit Issuance' reports in the DGO Inquiry may give issue dates but are postback pages (unread). Virginia is almost all coalbed methane and gas.
producer_plan: Option 1, history: query layer 0 (Active Wells) in pages of 2000 and count FiDrComp (drilling complete) and FiWellComp (well completion) by month, split by TblOpDesc; this measures wells drilled or completed, like New Mexico's spuds, with a lag. Option 2, permits going forward: query layer 4 (Permitted Undrilled Wells) and layer 1 (Pending Wells) every night and keep a log of each FiNo with its TblPsDesc and FiStatDt; the first night a FiNo appears with TblPsDesc 'Issued' and its FiStatDt gives an approximate issue month, and Pending Wells gives applications waiting. Wells leave layer 4 when drilled, so history cannot be rebuilt from it. Check whether FiStatDt on an 'Issued' row is the issue date (many fall on the same day in pairs and threes, which looks like batches, but this is not confirmed). Option 3: the DGO Inquiry 'Permit Issuance' and 'Permit Issuance Statistics' reports, if they give issue dates; they need an ASP.NET form post, which is fragile. The VGOB service is not started. Work type is not a field (new vs modification is separate layers: Pending Wells vs Pending Well Modifications).
privacy_notes: Layers hold company names (CoName) and farm names (FiFarm, often a landowner's family name); no phone or street address seen in the field list. A build needs a corporate-name filter on operators and should not publish farm names. The form collects owner addresses (not read).
